{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates
num_duplicates = df.duplicated().sum()

# Check for missing values
missing_values = df.isnull().sum()

# Check the range of sample_seq
sample_seq_range = df['sample_seq'].min(), df['sample_seq'].max()

# Check the unique values in 'sample_seq' and 'patient_id'
unique_sample_seq = df['sample_seq'].nunique()
unique_patient_id = df['patient_id'].nunique()

# Check if sample_seq has multiple entries per patient
sample_seq_per_patient = df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].nunique()

# Check if any patient has more than one sample_seq
patients_with_multiple_samples = sample_seq_per_patient[sample_seq_per_patient > 1].count()

# Summary
print(f'Duplicates: {num_duplicates}')
print(f'Missing values:\n{missing_values}')
print(f'sample_seq range: {sample_seq_range}')
print(f'Unique sample_seq: {unique_sample_seq}')
print(f'Unique patient_id: {unique_patient_id}')
print(f'Patients with multiple sample_seq: {patients_with_multiple_samples}')"}
